prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup image edit.
Image 1 is the edit target: the Tebo frosted-silver app screenshot the user selected. Preserve its three-column layout, window framing, all text, logo artwork, navigation, six equally sized tool rows, typography and functional icon colors. Do not switch to the other top-navigation concepts.
Image 2 is a reference for the BACKGROUND ART ONLY and the tactile gray button treatment. Do not reproduce its monitor, screen bezel, monitor stand, website, brands, partner logos, headings or any wording. The actual app stays Tebo.
Make a single polished revised screenshot preview, not code.
Change the controls: replace the vivid blue "Scan Mac" pill with a refined skeuomorphic graphite button: matte charcoal face, subtle convex top-to-bottom shading, a narrow bevel, fine lighter top edge and darker lower edge, realistic soft contact shadow, crisp white label and arrow. It should resemble a small physical button, calm and precise, not glossy candy plastic. The "File cleanup" selected segment becomes a raised pearl/silver button with dark lettering, subtle beveled rim and tiny shadow. The other workspace segment is softly inset. Make the selected Overview row a quiet silver-gray inset surface with dark icon and lettering, instead of a blue button. Keep the colored tool icons and subtle blue scan-ring accent. Other actual controls use matching pearl-gray tactile treatment. No neon-blue buttons.
Replace the blue cloudy outer wallpaper with a warm pale-gray backdrop inspired by image 2: photographic/illustrative human hand and gold embroidered fabric approaching from the lower left, refined robotic hand and teal/gold embroidered fabric approaching from the lower right, with a small open book between them near the lower background. Use only this artwork, absolutely none of the website or monitor content. Desaturate and soften the art so it works as an understated background behind the app. Cropped hand/fabric details can show at the outer lower edges; keep the book small and subtle. It must not overlap UI text or controls. Frosted sidebar edges may pick up only very faint diffuse tones from the background; central panels remain clean and readable. Neutral pearl/silver lighting, soft realistic materials, no dramatic glow.
Maintain the original image's app scale and proportions, the exact supplied Tebo mark, the labels "File cleanup" and "image cleanup", and all existing copy. Do not add features, new branding, scan values, extra objects, captions or a watermark. Show the whole window and keep all content visible. The result should look like a carefully designed native Mac app with tactile controls and a quiet art backdrop, not a web landing page.
